final:
-- Index of the chosen element, always in 0 to n - 1, a pure function of seed.
pick_index(n: int, seed: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 1
  post out >= 0 and out < n
  ex pick_index(1, 42) == 0
  let m = seed % 1000003
  let h = (m * 7919 + 12345) % 1000003
  h % n

-- The element at pick_index, so the same seed always gives the same element.
pick(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() >= 1
  ex pick([9], 42) == 9
  xs[pick_index(xs.len(), seed)]
